# Bug registry

This folder is the canonical registry of confirmed/tracked bugs across all three
benchmark suites. The table below is generated — **do not hand-edit it.**
Regenerate it (and check ID assignment) with:

```bash
uv run frb bug-registry
```

## Layout

```
bug_analysis/
├── README.md            (this file — the "Bug registry" section above is generated)
└── bugs/
    └── <BUG_ID>.md
```

One file per globally-unique bug ID — flat, no benchmark/binary folders.
`<BUG_ID>` is the bare ID used in `bug_descriptor.c` (e.g. `FRB52`, `FW19`,
`MF02`) — no `FP_` prefix, no `.md` duplication of the ID in the filename
beyond `<BUG_ID>.md`.
